summary: Aiken County state tower; the site record marks it removed, and no source read describes what remains today.

facts.status_note: The Eastern US Lookouts record marks the tower as Removed. The record gives no removal date.

evidence.supports: Wagener tower is in Aiken County, run by the South Carolina Forestry Commission
evidence.quote: South Carolina - Aiken County - South Carolina Forestry Commission

evidence.supports: Record marks the tower as removed
The first commission tower was erected in August 1930 near Camden
evidence.quote: The first Forestry Commission fire tower was erected in August, 1930 near Camden.

evidence.supports: Commission closed its fire tower system on October 1, 1993
evidence.quote: The Forestry Commission closed its fire tower system on October 1, 1993.

evidence.supports: Most tower sites had about 10 acres, the tower and a year-round dwelling
evidence.quote: Most tower sites consisted of 10 acres of land, the tower, and a year-round dwelling for the operator.

evidence.supports: From the 1960s most tower operators were women
evidence.quote: From the 1960s on, most South Carolina tower operators were women

evidence.supports: Operators' husbands frequently worked as firefighters
evidence.quote: frequently their husbands were employed as firefighters

evidence.supports: Towers were the public's point of contact for reporting fires and linked to firefighters
evidence.quote: Towers were the public's fire reporting contact point, and served as the communications link for firefighters in the field.

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The Wagener Weebly page gives only agency, county and Removed. No build date, height, design, staffing or removal date appears in any source read. Lead for the editor: a search returned an SC Historic Property Record entry titled Wagener Lookout Tower (https://schpr.sc.gov/index.php/Detail/objects/73790, Aiken County). That page is behind a human-verification check, so it was not read and is not cited. It may describe what remains at the site; check it before the today paragraph is considered final. The general system facts in the story come from the SCFC history page, not from Wagener-specific sources.
